notes.title: UI & XP System Polish
notes.content:
Added an indicator on a turret node to make it more noticeable where you can buy turrets.

Added a breakable object that works as a vacuum to easily collect experience gems.

notes.title: General bug fix & polishing
notes.content:
Fixed wandering traveler's positions and background props
Added new soundtracks
Added hit effect vfx & sfx
Adjusted first boss health

notes.title: Enemy Spawn Logic
notes.content: Fixed a bug where enemy spawn logic fails sometimes after returning to main menu and starting the game again.
